北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天寒地冻，注意保暖防寒，多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing, it's freezing! Stay warm, hydrate, bundle up.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，出行注意安全，体感偏冷，记得添衣。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi, foggy out! Drive safe, feels chilly. Wear extra layers.
慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微凉，湿度大，记得带伞，注意添衣保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai, cloudy and damp. Cool, bring an umbrella, stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温舒适，享受这美好的天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou, sunny and pleasant! Enjoy the lovely weather today.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有雾，小心驾驶，气温舒适，注意湿滑。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen, it's foggy! Drive carefully. Mild temps, watch for dampness.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴雨湿冷，出门别忘带伞，穿暖和些哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou, damp and chilly. Don't forget your umbrella, dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阵雨伴大风，体感寒冷！务必穿厚保暖防湿。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing, showers and strong winds. Feels freezing! Dress warmly, stay dry.
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度很高，注意添衣保暖，保持心情愉悦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu, cloudy and very humid. Stay warm, dress well, keep smiling!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨湿冷，体感非常低，务必多穿，小心着凉。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan, light rain and damp cold. Feels freezing! Bundle up, stay well.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感偏低，记得穿厚实点，注意保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an, cloudy and chilly. Feels colder, dress warmly and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆小雨，天气微凉湿润，出门记得带把伞哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing, light rain and mild. A bit damp, don't forget your umbrella!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，出门务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin, it's bitterly cold! Dress in full layers, protect from frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -30℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，出门注意保暖，阳光虽好，别忘了防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang, sunny but freezing! Dress warmly. Enjoy sun, stay bundled.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，气温微凉，享受这份冬日暖阳吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming, sunny and cool. Enjoy the beautiful winter sunshine!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云舒适，气温宜人，适合户外走走哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen, cloudy and comfortable. Perfect weather for a stroll outside!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷大风，体感极寒！多穿衣服，小心感冒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao, cloudy, windy, and freezing! Bundle up, avoid catching a cold.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，寒风刺骨，注意防风保暖，谨防冻伤。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian, cloudy with biting wind. Stay warm, protect from frostbite!
大连.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
